snippet.title: Spin Rhythm XD VR & PlayStation Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Spin Rhythm XD is coming to PS4, PS5 and PS VR2 on July 9 2024!

The all-new VR mode is coming to Steam for free on the same day!

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-au/concept/10003265
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058830/Spin_Rhythm_XD/
